title: Sweep residual pre-rename references
description:
Corrects the last mentions of the pre-rename names ("Project Lead" / `project-lead`, "JIT Plan" / `jit-plan`) left behind after the bulk rename to `jit-execution-lead` and `jit-planning-lead`, so no live document points at a name that no longer exists.

## Background

A prior change renamed the `project-lead` skill to `jit-execution-lead` and the `jit-plan` skill to `jit-planning-lead`, moving directories, symlinks, and most cross-references. Nine live mentions of the old names remain: the `jit-execution-lead` `SKILL.md` H1 heading (`# Project Lead`), the `jit-planning-lead` `SKILL.md` H1 heading (`# JIT Plan`) and its opening line ("a complete jit plan"), a `# Project-lead utility:` header comment atop each of the two dispatch scripts, and four mentions inside `dev/active/eed6750c-handoff.md` (its title, a skill-name mention, an untested-triggering note, and a pointer to `.claude/skills/jit-plan/` — the operationally load-bearing one, since it is the only surviving path reference to the old directory).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A case-insensitive grep for `(^|[^-])project[- ]lead|jit[- ]plan\b` over `.claude/skills/`, `scripts/`, and `dev/active/` documents attached to a non-Done issue returns zero hits, without matching `jit-execution-lead`, `jit-planning-lead`, or `jit-project-lead`.
- [hard] REQ-02: The nine known hits are corrected in place: `jit-execution-lead/SKILL.md`'s H1, `jit-planning-lead/SKILL.md`'s H1 and opening line, both dispatch scripts' header comment, and all four mentions in `dev/active/eed6750c-handoff.md` (including its `.claude/skills/jit-plan/` path pointer, updated to `.claude/skills/jit-planning-lead/`).
- [hard] REQ-03: `dev/active/` documents whose owning issue is already Done are left untouched. Live-scope `dev/active/` documents (owning issue non-Done) carrying residual old-name mentions are corrected as part of this sweep, in addition to the files REQ-02 names.

## Notes

Do not touch `dev/active/` plan docs, completion reports, or showcases attached to a Done issue (for example the 2e926e39, 9ac9fdac, and 2fbd2a82 records, and `planning-bracket-design.md` / `planning-bracket-showcase/`) — those are historical record, exempt by the same principle as `dev/sessions/`, `dev/studies/`, `dev/archive/`, and `.jit/`.
